notes.title: (April Fools) Garenburg Woods: Pink Eyes Release!
notes.notes:
To play Garenburg Woods: Pink Eyes, please follow these steps!

[b]Pink Eyes contains spoilers for the main game.[/b] Please only play it if you beat the true ending of the main game.

1. Right click the game in your library. Select "properties"
2. Select "betas" and then under "beta participation," choose "pinkeyes."
3. Wait for it to install.
4. Open the game! To revert back to the main game, you can set beta to "none." [b]Please note that loading any old saves WILL run into issues; just launch a new game.[/b]

Spoiler Note:
[spoiler]The singular track made for this "update" is available on Bandcamp [url=https://creatalsoft.bandcamp.com/album/garlicburger-woodland-original-soundtrack]here[/url]. Hope your start of April's going well![/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Steam Achievements! Happy New Year~
notes.notes:
A follow up to the past patch, thanks to the new engine, we now have... drum roll... achievements via Steam! Ta-da!

This is a follow up to the prior patch (you can see info of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/750610/view/507315632099821049]that update here[/url]) and mostly focuses on making sure all the achievement stuff is up and working.

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]

Achievements are checked once a minute, so if you open your past saves, just give it a minute or so and you should have them automatically unlock. You can also get your achievements unlocked on any save file, so if you have a separate save where you got some things done and another where you didn't, you will still get all achievements unlocked from those individual save files.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

Additionally, the following has been adjusted...
[list]
[*]Fixed some more typos
[*]Added a screen with additional credits for people for EasyRPG Player and help with the achievement integration
[*]C7: [spoiler]Added checks and handling to make sure that you have these achievements in case you met the criteria but it didn't activate properly[/spoiler]
[*]C9: [spoiler]Fixed issue where the Lime Green achievement wouldn't necessarily show as unlocked in the achievement area[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Save Files[/h2]
If your save files don't appear to be loading, sorry, that's an unfortunate side effect of this change; they're just in a different folder! Fortunately, follow these steps and they will be back and running as they haven't been deleted.

[olist]
[*]Right click the game in your library, go "manage" and then "browse local files."
[*]Navigate to the "Data" folder.
[*]Your save files should be there as Save.lsd! Drag it to the main folder and the game will detect them properly!
[/olist]

[h2]Outro[/h2]

That's all! As mentioned with the past update, if you want to see any merch we now have, you can see [url=https://garenburg.com/store.html]here[/url]. But besides that... Thank you for your time, and see you again with... [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844120/]Garenburg Penitence[/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 - Engine Updates, Merch, & Future
notes.notes:
Hello all!

This update is a pretty big one at the same time as pretty simple; it massively improves some features with the update at the same time as being not that different. If you already played through Garenburg Woods, you don't need to worry much about this update. That said, there is something planned you should still see that'll be coming!

[h2]Engine Improvements[/h2]

This main update puts us on [url=https://easyrpg.org/]EasyRPG Player[/url], a project that allows the game to run much better on modern platforms. This will mean that this should run more smoothly than before, have much more options and settings and features for toggling, and make it overall a better and less archaic experience. Huge thanks to EasyRPG Player for their great work with everything!

Thanks to EasyRPG Player, the following settings and features are now present...
[list]
[*]Video settings: Toggle full screen, window zoom, FPS counter, V-Sync, stretching, scaling methods, resolution, and pausing when focus is lost. I recommend leaving "Pause when focus lost" on. You no longer need to select windowed or full screen at launch, you can just toggle whenever you'd like!
[*]Audio settings: You can manually toggle the volume of sound effects and music now.
[*]Input settings: You can now change key bindings and gamepad support. And you can also use Fast Forward, which will make your movement and the game speed way quicker if you want to!
[/list]

Additionally, the following has been adjusted...
[list]
[*]Fixed various typos and grammar issues
[*]C8: [spoiler]Fixed the color of dialogue text when Vincent is speaking to match his prior dialogue; this was an unintentional oversight[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Save Files[/h2]
If your save files don't appear to be loading, sorry, that's an unfortunate side effect of this change; they're just in a different folder! Fortunately, follow these steps and they will be back and running as they haven't been deleted.

[olist]
[*]Right click the game in your library, go "manage" and then "browse local files."
[*]Navigate to the "Data" folder.
[*]Your save files should be there as Save.lsd! Drag it to the main folder and the game will detect them properly!
[/olist]

Sorry for the inconvenience! The folder structure moved slightly which offset things a little...

[h2]Achievements Plan[/h2]

Finally, there IS a planned update that will add in Steam Achievements! You'll be able to finally have the achievements you earn ingame on Steam! This only wasn't in it before because, well, the game is made in RPG Maker 2000. But I'm currently investigating the potential integration of Steam with it through EasyRPG Player. As of such, you may see some achievements for the game but it also showing nobody having them and them being unusable... If this doesn't work out, I'll adjust this post, but hopefully it ends up getting added because I'd really love to have them in this!

[h2]Merchandise[/h2]

Other than that, if you were curious of the art for this little update, here it is below. It's actually for a t-shirt; we're now selling merchandise at a little online shop! For more information, you can check it out [url=https://garenburg.com/store.html]here[/url]. The merchandise is made-per-order and it was mainly set up because I wanted my own merch, so...

[img]https://files.catbox.moe/lmjw3y.png[/img]

Other than that, thank you for reading! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844120/]Garenburg Penitence[/url] is still in development and should have its own news very soon...

Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Minor Tweaks and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Small update. Not a big patch. Mostly just adjusting a few things I'd been meaning to and... didn't!

[h1]Patch 1.0.3[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed an attack from Gown that it was never supposed to have and does basically nothing that was left in due to an oversight
[*]C7: [spoiler]Changed the music box music to the new track "Brother." This track is also present in the Bandcamp / Spotify uploads of the soundtrack, it's due to copyright as the original track was an arrangement of something.[/spoiler]
[*]C7: [spoiler]Redid how the shadows cause harm to the player during the music box scene. Previously, they would do 100 damage to the party and give a one second delay before the both it and the player can resume moving, but as a result, it would cause a delay in the music and make everything no longer sync properly. Instead, they will do 75 damage to the entire party and move away from the player, but there is no time buffer for the player to better avoid being harmed again.[/spoiler]
[*]C7: [spoiler]Fixed bug where the save box still appears in RISK Mode if you do not use it during the music box scene.[/spoiler]
[*]C7: [spoiler]Music box scene is now longer and has another color tint at the end, initial position for shadows are also moved[/spoiler]
[*]C7: [spoiler]Shadows are no longer transparent during the music box scene[/spoiler]
[*]Credits images are now the proper resolution and remade (they look nearly the same though)
[*]Slight adjustment to credits names to account for the names of said people changing
[*]Changed the game icon
[/list]
---------------------------------------------------------

That is all! Thank you for reading, and take care!

notes.title: 1st Anniversary, Price Reduction, Free Copy of Garenburg Penitence!
notes.notes:
Hi!

After much consideration, [i]Garenburg Woods[/i] will have a permanent price reduction to $2.99 USD.

In the end, my goal is to make a game and one I am happy with as well as one that others can play and experience for themselves. A price reduction helps make the game more accessible, and that is something I value more than monetary gain.

The $2.99 price point is also going to be my goal going forwards for many other games I made in the future. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844120/Garenburg_Penitence_The_Riflebird/]Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird[/url] (the next Garenburg game) will follow suite. 

To say thanks to anybody who has already purchased [i]Garenburg Woods[/i], [b]you can get a free copy of [i]Garenburg Penitence[/i][/b] once it releases and be in the special thanks for the game! To do so, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/zZR8zQgHsk]official Discord server[/url] and make a ticket in [b]#tickets[/b] with a link to your Steam profile.

This change will take place on [b]September 29th[/b], the 1st anniversary of the game release, and please be sure to make the ticket before that date so we can make sure we can get you on the list of people to give the free copy to.

There's going to be other surprises as this month continues to celebrate the first anniversary, so stay tuned for more!

Cheers!

notes.title: Garenburg Penitence Announcement / Garenburg Woods Planned Content Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here's some news about the state of Garenburg.

[h1]Garenburg Penitence: The Riflebird[/h1]
The second game in the Garenburg series is in development!

The gameplay is firing spheres and matching colors. This game is heavily influenced and inspired by a few titles, including Luxor, Sparkle, Tumblebugs and other marble popper games from the 2000s, Irisu Syndrome, and Serial Experiments Lain (for the PlayStation 1). I realize those are weird inspirations, but they are there for a reason.

For those who have played through [i]Garenburg Woods[/i], I feel that it is important to mention that [i]Garenburg Penitence[/i] is a very different game in gameplay, format, and style. You may not enjoy the games for the same reasons. This new entry [i]will[/i] be very story-driven however, and if you paid attention at the campfire stories, some story elements may be familiar with the [i]Garenburg Penitence.[/i] This new game will be going into much more detail about the events that had happened during the Lunacy, and flesh out the world further. It is not required to play [i]Garenburg Woods[/i] to understand the story of [i]Garenburg Penitence.[/i]

For much more information about the game, please see the links below that go into more detail about it!

[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844120/Garenburg_Penitence_The_Riflebird/]Steam Page[/url]
[*][url=https://penitence.garenburg.com/]Official Website[/url]
[*][url=https://news.garenburg.com/2022/02/garenburg-penitence-announcement.html]Information Post[/url]
[/list]

[h1]Garenburg Woods: Planned Future Content[/h1]
Garenburg Woods will see new content at some point in the future. I'm not quite sure when as I haven't begun working on it yet, but I have been planning out what I want to do for it. What will be added is a few QOL changes and more notably, a large, post-game dungeon that will offer a different experience. It will require the true ending being completed, include all previous bosses and enemies, as well as new ones and be climbing through a giant tree.

This may take a while before it is finished due to focus being on Garenburg Penitence, but I felt like it was important to note. This idea was originally for the base release but was scrapped due to complications, scope, and time, so I'm very excited to add it in. It will be a free update.

In addition to this, a patch will roll out sometime in March to add a few fixes to Garenburg Woods and adjustments. I will be looking into Steam trading cards and emotes as well to be added.

[h1]Closing[/h1]
We have a [url=https://twitter.com/Creatalsoft]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/garenburg/]Reddit![/url] They are for mainly just news and answering questions. They are r/garenburg and @Creatalsoft and will have more updates on these games in the future.

Well, that's pretty much it. I'm quite excited to continue working on these projects. Thank you for reading, and I'm excited to share more information in the near future. Cheers!

notes.title: Full Game Release Date - September 29th
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Garenburg Woods will finally be releasing on September 29th, 2021. This game has been in development for a long time, but is now polished and completed in its content. A more detailed post about the development of the game (with spoilers) will be made in the coming days for anybody interested in its development period and why it's taken a long while, but it will be releasing very soon.

The game will be on sale at launch for 40% off, and the soundtrack will be available separately for free with additionally scrapped and unused tracks, a collection of tracks with a glockenspiel version, concept art, and more.

For anybody who has been interested in the game these past years, a sincere thank you for your patience! Have a good one, and I hope you enjoy the experience!

A final trailer is now available below. [previewyoutube=M3msApqzOv0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Garenburg Novellas
notes.notes:
Hello!

I'm pleased to announce the creation of [url=https://novella.garenburg.com/]Garenburg.com[/url], a website that will contain information about the world this game takes place in. Feel free to read through the novellas as there will be multiple updates over time and there are no spoilers for this game. They are meant to provide insight and translate some small stories that are part of Garenburg into text form. Enjoy, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

Sorry for the large delay in the release. The game development has gone well but I'd like to polish things and make it much better before release. There currently isn't a 100% planned release date, but I should finish sometime before July 4th, 2019. The game will have a lot of content and things to do luckily, and you'll be able to obtain multiple endings on the same save file.

Something I may do before the release of the game is make a small project with a lot of assets from the main project and have the side game be available for free and be kind of like a demo. It would be a very short prequel, and not be very polished but it would be a nice addition.

The soundtrack will be released with a separate purchase from the main game and include artwork for the game along with a trivia document and some more stuff. The soundtrack currently is over two hours long, so it'll be pretty nice. Extra tracks that were not used in the game will be included with the soundtrack. Most of the tracks will be an m4a file, otherwise they will be mp3. 

There is additional information about Garenburg and the history of the island, and you can find some information about the place [url=https://sites.google.com/site/garenburg111/]here.[/url] It contains extra insight on events prior to this game, during, and afterwards. It will be continually updated with new content.

Lastly, Garenburg Woods will have updates after completion to fix bugs, add some extra content, and be better overall. The game will be released completed so don't worry about it missing anything. After all updates are released for Garenburg Woods, there will be a definitive version that is released as free DLC as it may break save files. I'll do my best to prevent save file issues, though.

Thanks for reading and hopefully everything will be done soon! Stay on trail...
~Merso Aweheo

notes.title: Garenburg Woods - Production Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Garenburg Woods is going pretty well, with plenty of new stuff being added that previously was not planned. There's now quite a bit of new party members, customization, achievements, various props... It's going well and the game is over half way complete!

That being said, the game is going to take longer than planned, and now I'm pretty sure the game will be finished in April, instead of January. Apologies!

However, the game is going to be pretty interesting and feature quite a bit of more content now, so I'm hoping that everything goes well so I can finish this as soon as possible. Here's a nice little game track (link at bottom!) as apologies, and on January 26th, I'll put a nice new trailer up to celebrate the second birthday of Creatalsoftware Games. Stay on trail, and see you then!
